title: North District Clinic: POD Suspended — Paper Mode Request

transcript.speaker: Nurse Carla
transcript.text: Dr. Raman, this is Nurse Carla again. The walk-in MMR clinic here is on hold. We can't access ClinicTrack to verify patient histories or confirm vaccine doses. The paper records are incomplete — 30 children don’t have a record of their first dose, so we can’t give a second. We have 147 people here, including 64 children under 5. The parents are starting to panic. We need to know if we can continue in paper mode.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Neha Raman
transcript.text: Nurse Carla, I’m on it. I’m activating paper mode per EOP 4.3 and notifying IT and the Incident Commander. The paper line list is MCHD-F-12, and we’re using MCHD-F-40 for clinic records. Confirm that all staff have access to the DOC kit in Room B, and that the paper intake form MCHD-F-10 is being used for new cases.

transcript.speaker: Nurse Carla
transcript.text: Affirmative, Dr. Raman. We’ve pulled the DOC kit from Room B. The team is switching to MCHD-F-40 and MCHD-F-12. We’ll hold until you confirm the paper mode status.

voiceStyles.Nurse Carla: Woman in her 30s, urgent, background noise of children crying
voiceStyles.Dr. Neha Raman: Woman in her 40s, calm but firm, composed

instructorNote: This inject confirms the activation of paper mode. Watch for Epi to declare paper mode in the EOP and for IT to confirm system status. Epi must now begin case investigation using the paper line list and MCHD-F-10.
